name: Hunter of the Woods — Level-3-equivalent beast benchmark

identity.focus_feature_notes: Hunter is a living, non-Archetype natural beast with no Focus and no personal Veil invocations. Benchmark rank3 is a Vigor and Turn AP comparison anchor, not character Level/CR/XP. Physical24 and natural regen +0 are creature-local provisional B06 mappings.

physiology_notes: Large, bulky forest quadruped, exceeding ordinary bear mass; wolf-like head, powerful legs, one prominent horn and venomous puncturing bite and strong jaws.
1×2-square rigid footprint; translation/turning follows Multi-Square Creature Footprints v0. No automatic added Reach, Armor, Guard or attack cadence.
Horn serves primarily mating-season rutting, territorial intimidation and deterrence, and breaking up loose material/roots when enlarging an excavated den.

B06 physiology lock candidate: Vitality+4, Agility+2, Awareness+2; HP14 from 10+Vitality, natural hide Armor3 (uniform; no worn-armor Dodge cap), Dodge14 at first use then −2 per previous Dodge. No anatomical natural Guard instrument; no personal Veil invocation.

B06 rank-3-equivalent local Vigor anchor: (10+Vitality4)×3=42 Vigor, non-Focus regeneration +0 giving 4 per actual own-turn Regeneration Step at 1 Vigor per point, and 11 Vigor Recovery per completed six hours (25%, round half-up, cap42). These values require opposed encounter calibration; no size-based HP multiplier, virtual exploration Regeneration Step or exertion stamina system.

Venom apparatus: paired modified salivary glands supply grooves in existing reinforced upper canines; delivery occurs only on genuinely puncturing Bite, not horn/contact. Single central frontal-cranial horn has bony core/keratin sheath; neck/skull reinforced for rutting, deterring rivals and den excavation.

Phase 2 executable v0 fixture: STR+4, AGI+2, Precision+1, Intelligence−2, Awareness+2, Presence−1, VIT+4, Veil Affinity0/Control0, Initiative+4, Turn AP42/Physical24, 12 MP, one latent Guard capacity with no legal natural Guard instrument and one Opportunity/Reaction. Bite +6 (STR4+AGI2), Horn +5 (STR4+Precision1), Pounce/Drive pressure +4 (STR4). V0 numeric benchmark, not CR.
behavior_notes: Apex woodland ambush predator able to hunt deer/elk and sometimes moose; stalks, uses explosive pounce/bite and attempts to bring prey down.

If the pounce fails to take prey down but the independently successful bite genuinely punctures, venom may still be delivered; it can withdraw, track scent/sign and attempt to finish weakened prey later.
Conserves energy and avoids unnecessary injury; tracking, withdrawal and rest from exertion are ordinary animal behavior, not automatically a Vigor expenditure/recovery.
May threaten competitors with horn displays, defend a den, retreat from a costly encounter or interact with approaching humans without automatically attacking.

footprint.reference_rule: Stable 1-based body-local indices: 1=head (reference), 2=rear. Labels remain with anatomical cells through translation, 90/180-degree pivots and legal repositioning; no post-movement coordinate re-sort.

defenses.armor_name: Natural dense hide/dermis — uniform single creature, no worn armor stacking
defenses.resistance_notes: Normal living-beast resistances only. No generic toxin immunity, Fire resistance, free head/rear defenses, Guard instrument, free anti-regeneration, size-derived modifiers or latent special senses. One latent derived Guard capacity is unusable without a separately authored instrument. Dying and ordinary wounds apply.

start_states.condition: Unwounded living Hunter; rigid 1×2 rear/head positioned with known cardinal head-forward orientation; no prior Dodge pressure or Reaction spent. Head and rear share one HP/Vigor pool. At Round Begin refresh one physically unusable Guard budget, one Opportunity capacity, one Reaction; do not create an ambush surprise advantage without actual scenario checks.

attack_profiles.name: Hunter natural grooved-canine Bite

primary_hp_packet.source: Hunter grooved-canine Bite B06-local includes all damage contribution: exactly 3+d6 Piercing Pen1, never +Strength again

toxin_delivery.explicit_source: B06-SRC-HUNTER-GROOVED-CANINES — paired grooved upper canines and salivary venom apparatus

attack_profiles.critical_notes: One natural Bite with one defense assignment and standard critical confirmation; toxin application only on surviving after-prevention Piercing puncture; DC12 Vitality resistance once for valid new accepted exposure, Full/Reduced 10/30/60/120-minute clock; no immediate poison penalty.

attack_profiles.name: Hunter frontal Horn Bash

primary_hp_packet.source: Hunter frontal Horn Bash B06-local includes all damage contribution: exactly 2+d6 Crush Pen0, never +Strength again

attack_profiles.critical_notes: One ordinary head-forward Horn Bash. Standard natural-attack critical process. No toxin, fear, shove, second attack, movement or Guard capability.

attack_profiles.name: Hunter Pounce — one linked Bite and independent balance rider

primary_hp_packet.source: Hunter grooved-canine Bite B06-local includes all damage contribution: exactly 3+d6 Piercing Pen1, never +Strength again

toxin_delivery.explicit_source: B06-SRC-HUNTER-GROOVED-CANINES — paired grooved upper canines and salivary venom apparatus

attack_profiles.critical_notes: One paid 24-AP Pounce with one Bite attack and, only if forceful front contact remains, one separately resolved non-attack Balance contest after Bite/injection/wound/Dying. No extra Bite or second defense response; a blocked/missed Bite may still allow the balance contest. If target unable to resist after Bite, use Trip unable-to-contest automatic Prone when physically valid.

linked_contest.response_rule: Single defender response to the Bite before the attack roll; AFTER final Bite damage/injection/possible incapacitation, eligible active defender chooses Strength or Agility and contests d20+4 against d20+ability+applicable specific Training. Tie holds standing. Dying/incapable defender uses Trip unable-to-contest if standing and valid. No second attack/defense window.

attack_profiles.name: Hunter Horn Drive — canonical Shove instead of Horn Bash
attack_profiles.weapon_or_source: B06-SRC-HUNTER-FRONTAL-HORN and shoulders, head-forward whole-body contact
attack_profiles.critical_notes: No attack roll and no HP packet: declare alternative 24-AP physical Shove with normal Close-Contact Opportunity, strict opposed win and full rigid-1x2 legal advance; no venom or Horn Bash damage.

linked_contest.response_rule: Canonical Shove: attacker d20+4 vs defender d20+Strength+specific Training+2 Hold Ground+Anchoring; tie blocks. Legal Close-Contact Opportunity before contest; successful hit there gives Shove −2 situational modifier and may invalidate maneuver. Strict win displaces PC one square forward and advances whole 1×2 Hunter one square, otherwise neither moves if destination blocked.

action_policy: B06 provisional Level3-equivalent Turn AP42; local Physical Action24 (one paid Bite, Horn Bash, Pounce or Horn Drive per turn), 18 AP left; no spontaneous 2nd physical attack. General Tempo24 is legal if independently authored, but after one 24AP action 18 remaining cannot buy it. No Projection Actions, spells or personal VP.

One 12-MP ordinary allowance per own turn, base 2 MP orthogonal and 3 MP diagonal per valid whole-1x2 translation. All translation and pivots must respect stable head/rear cells, entire-body clearance and per-cell terrain cost average; a pivot is paid ordinary movement, not a free Pounce heading change.

Pounce is strict head-forward cardinal Charge variant, starts without prior MP spent/reserved, minimum 3 translated steps, 2×effective M movement cap (unimpaired24), provisional rapid cutoff floor(3M/2)=18; AP commits at crossing cutoff or before eligible attack; unused extended movement discarded. End front-adjacent to one standing one-square PC, no lateral/rear Pounce, no free Grapple.

Normal Bite and Horn Bash each require immediately head-forward adjacency to one square PC for v0. An ordinary pivot can reorient before an attack; no creature-wide omnidirectional Reach granted from two cells.

Horn Drive is a separately declared paid Shove against one standing one-square PC in immediate head-forward square, not a free Bash rider. Canonical Close-Contact Opportunity and −2 Pressure if it hits, defender +2 Hold Ground, rigid 1×2 built-in advance only after a strict winning contest and clear destination.

Hunter Pounce resolves one paid Bite+venom first, then separately one free forceful balance contest on still-eligible standing contact; pressure d20+4. No extra physical-action AP, defense response or second toxin registration. Horn cannot be substituted for committed Pounce Bite.

Tracking prey, retreating, pouncing or waiting for toxin onset do not automatically spend/replenish Vigor. No spontaneous HP regeneration outside an actual Regeneration Step, no magical stealth/invisibility or guaranteed surprise.
defense_policy: Initiative d20+Agility2+Awareness2=d20+4, no automatic ambush initiative/surprise bonus. Ordinary one Reaction refreshes Round Begin but has no invented reaction-only attack feature.
Dodge14 first, then 12/10/8 under +2 Dodge Pressure per previous chosen Dodge in same round; reset at Round Begin. Choose Take Hit when desirable; no per-cell separate defense.

Derived Physical Tempo=floor(42/24)=1, so base Guard capacity1 and Opportunity capacity1 at Round Begin. Guard instrument/Guard Defense absent, so personal Guard response illegal despite unused capacity; ordinary legal Opportunity Attack may use a frontal Bite or Horn Bash, not Horn Drive.

Natural Armor3 reduces one packet after penetration; no extra Agility cap or stacking. Regeneration Step restores at most 4 actual missing HP or lawful Repair Progress, costing equal Vigor. Six-hour Vigor Recovery11 caps at42.
scenario_constraints: No independent Veil invocation, no Focus/AP conversion or natural-weapon Training automatically supplied. Strength4 and Agility2 produce Bite+6; Strength4+Precision1 produce Horn+5; no Training or situational modifier; Pounce/Horn Drive pressure uses Strength4 alone. The horn and bite ability pairings are Hunter-local, not general new natural-weapon rules.
Natural Bite damage is exactly 3+d6 Piercing Pen1 and Horn Bash exactly 2+d6 Crush Pen0, not plus another STR4, Light Physical Contribution, or extra collision mass.

Only a genuine unprevented remaining Piercing puncture through grooved canines after mitigation (or separately proven breached route) allows one slow toxin application. One existing active instance blocks equal/lower-grade reexposure; use DC12 Vitality Full/Reduced and delayed T+10/T+30/T+60/T+120 clocks; no immediate penalty or Fire substitute.

Pounce Force +4 is distinct from Bite Attack +6, uses a single after-Bite free balance contest, and can still succeed on Bite miss/Guard. No Grapple/Pin, Prone displacement or force from second cell. Incapable defender uses canonical Trip unable-to-contest only with physically legal standing contact.

Horn Drive Shove Pressure +4, reduced to +2 by a qualifying Close-Contact Opportunity hit, versus d20+defender Strength+Training+2 Hold Ground+Anchoring. A clear full-body advance and target destination are required; no raw HP, toxin, damage on blocked displacement or direct advance through third parties.

B06 status EXECUTABLE_TEST_FIXTURE means mechanically sourced, deterministic benchmark inputs in the schema. It does NOT certify a full encounter engine, simulation, any opponent balance outcome, level equivalence or numerical CR.

formula_checks: Nine ability anchors STR4 AGI2 PRECI1 INT−2 AWA2 PRES−1 VIT4 VA0 VC0 are authored local beast statistics; not a PC point buy or universal beast species template.
HP=10+VIT4=14; Vigor=(10+VIT4)×rank3=42; natural Armor3; Agility cap null; no size multiplier or second square HP.
Bite=d20+STR4+AGI2+Training0+situational0=d20+6; exactly 3+d6 Piercing Pen1 with all physical damage included.
Horn Bash=d20+STR4+Precision1+Training0+situational0=d20+5; exactly 2+d6 Crush Pen0 with all damage included.
Pounce Pressure=d20+STR4+Pounce Training0=d20+4; Horn Drive Shove Pressure=d20+STR4+relevant Training0=d20+4 (subject to legal Close-Contact Opportunity −2).
Turn AP=min(120,30+6×(3−1))=42; B06 local Physical24; Physical Tempo=floor(42/24)=1; base Guard1 (unusable without instrument), Opportunity capacity1 and Reaction1. One physical attack leaves 18 AP.
Ordinary M12; Pounce 2M24, cutoff floor(3M/2)=18, minimum three translated steps, head-forward cardinal and whole-1×2 clearance.
Non-Focus local Regeneration throughput=max(VIT4,0)+0=4 per actual own-turn Step; Vigor spent one per recovered HP/Repair Progress; completed 6h Vigor Recovery half-up(42×0.25)=11, capped at42.
Bite and Pounce delivery include same true puncture gate, DC12 Vitality resistance and nonstacking pursuit toxin, no second injector or toxin attack; Horn Bash and Horn Drive have no toxin.
known_exclusions: No proven numerical encounter rank, CR, XP, TP, environmental frequency, TTK or actual fights simulated; intended elite encounter scenarios remain labelled untested.
No new species-wide natural weapon attack pairings, animal armor scaling, additional horn Guard, natural attack training inheritance or body-mass kinetic packet.
No PC progression/Talent/Archetype/Focus, personally Available/Committed/Spent VP, supernatural sensory range, universal special smell bonus, magical powers or innate immune states.

Pounce/Drive only authored versus standing corporeal ordinary one-square PC and actual physical terrain; multi-square target takedown/Grapple, exotic unsupported targets, complex mass and mounted uses are deferred.
A linked contest is not a bonus action or an additional attack. Pounce has one Bite damage event/defender response; Horn Drive has no damage attack roll at all.
Normal animal behavior is not new initiative advantage, implicit stealth action or automatic extra Vigor recovery.
validation.certification_status: Schema-valid B06-EN-03 executable benchmark fixture for authored one-square-target Bite, venom, Pounce, Horn Bash and Horn Drive mechanics; provisional v0 physiology/economy preserved. No actual opposed fight, statistical calibration, CR or MVP encounter certification yet.
